purpose: Turn one public-safe FIELD gap into one bounded mission and evidence-bearing RETURN, while allowing the exact same mission to be viewed through FIELD or PLAIN as a representation ablation rather than a second workflow.
laws: ONE MISSION ID ACROSS FIELD / PLAIN
PRIVATE/MEDICAL/MESSAGING ADAPTERS EXCLUDED FROM PUBLIC DECK
representative_interaction: ROLL or open #issue=N → keep the same mission → choose FIELD or PLAIN → OPEN TARGET → perform one bounded move → record PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL + evidence/residue + clarity/re-entry/use-again → COPY RETURN JSON; toggle projection and repeat without changing mission identity.

validation.public_safe_filter: PASS_BY_SOURCE_RULE: excludes /port, /continuity, /care, /field-intake, /router-bench, /atlas-dayline and private/clinical/vet/messaging/encrypted/sensor-bind gaps from public deck.

shared_presentation.rule: density changes representation only; mission identity/authority/return packet stay invariant

known_gap: No submission transport or shared scoreboard by design. Comparative FIELD↔PLAIN preference remains an ordinary-use observation, not correctness proof; contributor returns are copied and reviewed before any repo mutation.
